items.title_cn: 肠鸣音预测急性胰腺炎严重程度：一项前瞻性多中心研究方案
items.title_en: Bowel sound in predicting the severity of acute pancreatitis: Protocol of a prospective, multi-center study
items.abstract_cn: 背景 急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种常见疾病，约20%的患者会发展为重症急性胰腺炎（SAP），其预后较差。早期识别SAP患者并及时干预对于改善临床结局至关重要。本研究旨在探讨肠鸣音（BS）监测是否有助于在AP患者中早期识别SAP。方法 本研究是一项前瞻性、多中心预后研究。我们将从2024年4月1日起，在三个中心的急诊科连续招募发病48小时内新诊断的AP患者，且入组时尚未发展为SAP。入组后，每位患者将使用标准化设备和流程接受至少48小时的连续肠鸣音监测。主要结局是住院前7天内SAP的发生。收集的肠鸣音数据将使用自动化算法进行分析，以得出五个肠鸣音声学参数：肠鸣音发生率、主频率、持续时间、振幅和肠鸣音间期。这些参数将用作SAP的预测因子。肠鸣音分析人员将对患者的临床信息和结局设盲，治疗临床医生在研究期间将无法获取肠鸣音分析结果。我们将计算受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线和曲线下面积（AUC）以评估其预测性能。讨论 本研究探讨肠鸣音监测作为一种无创、实时工具用于评估AP严重程度。早期BS变化与预后相关，可提供与传统评分互补的连续生理学信息。尽管存在临床干预等混杂因素，初步数据显示SAP中BS减弱。标准化方案和降噪算法提高了可靠性。在机制上，BS反映肠道运动功能障碍，有助于早期发现病情恶化。未来工作将验证BS指导的干预措施，以优化AP管理。试验注册 ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06867120 中国医学研究注册与备案信息系统 MR-11-25-024794
items.abstract_en: Background Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a common condition, with approximately 20% of patients developing severe acute pancreatitis (SAP), which is associated with a poor prognosis. Early identification and timely intervention for SAP patients are essential for improving clinical outcomes. This study aims to investigate whether bowel sound (BS) monitoring could facilitate the early recognition of SAP in AP patients. Methods This study is a prospective, multi-center prognostic study. We will consecutively recruit newly diagnosed AP patients within 48h of disease onset who have not developed SAP at enrollment from the emergency departments of three centers from 01/04/2024. Upon enrollment, each patient will undergo continuous bowel sound monitoring for at least 48 hours using standardized equipment and procedures. The primary outcome is the occurrence of SAP within the first 7 days of hospitalization. Collected bowel sound data will be analyzed using an automated algorithm to derive five bowel sound acoustic parameters: bowel sound occurrence rate, dominant frequency, duration, amplitude, and inter-bowel-sound interval. These parameters will be used as predictors of SAP. Bowel sound analysts will be blinded to patients’ clinical information and outcomes, and treating clinicians will not have access to the bowel sound analysis results during the study. We will calculate the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve and area under the curve (AUC) to evaluate their predictive performance. Discussion This study explores bowel sound monitoring as a non-invasive, real-time tool for assessing AP severity. Early BS changes correlate with prognosis, offering continuous physiological insights complementary to traditional scores. Despite confounders like clinical interventions, preliminary data show BS attenuation in SAP. Standardized protocols and noise-cancellation algorithms enhance reliability. Mechanistically, BS reflects intestinal dysmotility, aiding early deterioration detection. Future work will validate BS-guided interventions to optimize AP management. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06867120 Chinese Medical Research Registration and Filing Information System MR-11-25-024794
items.summary_cn: 该研究是一项前瞻性多中心预后研究方案，旨在探讨肠鸣音监测能否在急性胰腺炎患者中早期识别重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）。研究将对发病48小时内入组且尚未发展为SAP的AP患者进行至少48小时连续肠鸣音监测，以住院前7天内SAP发生为主要结局，并通过自动化算法提取肠鸣音发生率、主频、持续时间、振幅和肠鸣音间期五个声学参数，利用ROC曲线和AUC评估其预测性能。

items.title_cn: 复发性急性胰腺炎的营养管理：证据、不确定性与临床决策
items.title_en: Nutritional Management of Recurrent Acute Pancreatitis: Navigating Evidence, Uncertainty, and Clinical Decision-Making
items.abstract_cn:
摘要

综述目的 本综述旨在探讨复发性急性胰腺炎（RAP）患者疾病全程中基于循证的营养管理策略。RAP患者群体以反复发作的炎症事件、累积性营养状况恶化为特征，且进展为慢性胰腺炎（CP）的风险增加。本综述探讨了关于营养支持最佳时机和途径的关键问题，以及胰腺外分泌功能不全（EPI）、胃肠道并发症、代谢紊乱和微量营养素缺乏的识别与治疗。

近期发现 尽管当前证据表明，在AP中早期肠内营养可减少感染性并发症并改善临床结局，但在反复发作间期的营养管理方面仍存在重要空白。在反复发作过程中，EPI的累积效应、持续性胃肠道症状和代谢紊乱可能导致进行性营养不良、肌少症和生活质量下降。在AP期间及之后对EPI的识别有所增加；然而，RAP中反复的胰腺损伤使患者面临持续性或进行性外分泌和内分泌功能障碍的特别高风险，需要持续监测和优化胰腺酶替代治疗（PERT）。反复的炎症事件可能加速胰腺结构损伤及向CP的进展，凸显了早期识别和治疗营养并发症的必要性。

总结 总体而言，营养管理是RAP照护中关键但发展不足的组成部分。未来需要进一步研究和更严谨的研究设计，以了解RAP的营养管理如何影响复发发作的频率和严重程度。

利益冲突声明 本文作者报告无与本文章相关的潜在利益冲突。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Purpose of Review This review aims to examine evidence-based nutrition management strategies across the continuum of disease in patients with recurrent acute pancreatitis (RAP), a population characterized by repeated inflammatory episodes, cumulative nutritional decline, and increased risk of progression to chronic pancreatitis (CP). It addresses key questions regarding optimal timing and delivery of nutrition support, as well as the identification and treatment of exocrine pancreatic insufficiency (EPI), gastrointestinal complications, metabolic derangements, and micronutrient deficiencies. Recent Findings Although current evidence demonstrates reduced infectious complications and improved clinical outcomes with early enteral nutrition in AP, important gaps persist regarding nutritional management between recurrent episodes. Across recurrent episodes, cumulative effects of EPI, persistent gastrointestinal symptoms, and metabolic derangements may contribute to progressive malnutrition, sarcopenia, and declining quality of life. Recognition of EPI during and after AP has increased; however, recurring pancreatic injury in RAP places patients at particularly high risk for persistent or progressive exocrine and endocrine dysfunction necessitating ongoing surveillance and optimization of PERT. Repeated inflammatory events may accelerate structural pancreatic damage and progression toward CP, underscoring the need for early identification and treatment of nutritional complications. Summary Overall, nutritional management is a critical, yet underdeveloped component of RAP care. Future research and stronger study designs are necessary to understand how nutritional management of RAP impacts the frequency and severity of recurrent attacks. Disclosure No potential conflicts of interest relevant to this article were reported.
items.summary_cn: 该综述指出，尽管早期肠内营养在急性胰腺炎中可减少感染并发症并改善临床结局，但复发性急性胰腺炎患者发作间期的营养管理仍存在显著证据缺口；反复发作导致的胰腺外分泌功能不全、持续胃肠道症状和代谢紊乱可促进营养不良、肌少症及生活质量下降，并加速向慢性胰腺炎进展，因此需早期识别并优化胰酶替代治疗及营养并发症管理。

items.title_cn: 乳酸林格液与生理盐水用于急性胰腺炎液体复苏：一项系统评价
items.title_en: Lactated Ringer Versus Normal Saline for Fluid Resuscitation in Acute Pancreatitis: A Systematic Review
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎（AP）需要早期液体复苏，而最佳液体选择仍不确定。本综述比较了乳酸林格液（LR）与生理盐水（NS）在成人AP中的应用，主要关注24小时时的全身炎症反应综合征（SIRS）。遵循系统评价和荟萃分析首选报告项目（PRISMA）2020指南，本综述检索了PubMed、ScienceDirect、ClinicalTrials.gov、Europe PMC、EBSCO Open Dissertations和Cochrane Library，纳入2015年1月1日至2025年10月31日发表的研究。我们筛选了1，324条记录的标题和摘要以及14篇全文报告。在14篇报告中，有6篇符合本综述的纳入标准。其中包括3项小型随机对照试验（RCT）和3项荟萃分析（MA）。在整个综述中，LR始终与较低的ICU入住率相关。此外，短期炎症标志物——如SIRS和C反应蛋白（CRP）——倾向于显示LR组改善更早，而死亡率和住院时间（LOH）相关的结果则不太一致，且通常未达到统计学显著性。早期液体复苏是AP治疗的核心部分，但最佳晶体液仍不确定。通过回顾近期RCT和MA，本综述支持LR在生理学和临床上优于NS。本综述还指出了当前证据仍然有限且异质性较大的领域。未来研究的建议包括开展一项更大规模、多中心、采用标准化复苏方案的随机试验，以确保足够的统计效能。需要一项更大规模的试验来确立明确结论，特别是针对现有文献中结果混杂或效能不足的结局。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis (AP) requires early fluid resuscitation, and the optimal choice of fluid remains uncertain. This review compared lactated Ringer (LR) with normal saline (NS) in adult AP, with a primary focus on systemic inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS) at 24 hours. Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020, this review explored PubMed, ScienceDirect, ClinicalTrials.gov, Europe PMC, EBSCO Open Dissertations, and the Cochrane Library for studies published from January 1, 2015 to October 31, 2025. We screened titles and abstracts of 1,324 records and 14 full-text reports. Out of the 14 reports, six met the inclusion criteria of our review. This included three small randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and three meta-analyses (MAs). Throughout the review, LR was consistently associated with lower rates of intensive care unit (ICU) admissions. In addition, short-term inflammatory markers - such as SIRS and C-reactive protein (CRP) - tended to demonstrate earlier improvement with LR, while findings related to mortality and length of hospital (LOH) stay were less consistent and often did not reach statistical significance. Early fluid resuscitation is a central part of AP care, yet the optimal crystalloid has remained uncertain. By reviewing recent RCTs and MAs, the review supports that LR is physiologically and clinically better than NS. This review also highlights areas where current evidence remains limited and heterogeneous. Suggestions for future research include conducting a larger, multicenter randomized trial with standardized resuscitation protocols to ensure adequate statistical power. A more extensive trial is needed to establish a definitive conclusion, particularly for outcomes that have mixed or underpowered results in the available literature.
items.summary_cn: 该综述比较了乳酸林格液与生理盐水在急性胰腺炎早期液体复苏中的效果，发现乳酸林格液与较低的ICU入住率相关，且SIRS和CRP等短期炎症指标倾向于更早改善，但死亡率和住院时长方面的结果不一致且多未达统计学显著性。作者认为乳酸林格液在生理和临床上优于生理盐水，但现有证据有限且异质性较大，需更大规模的多中心随机试验来确立明确结论。

items.title_cn: 超声内镜检查后胰腺炎风险：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.title_en: RISK OF PANCREATITIS FOLLOWING ENDOSCOPIC ULTRASONOGRAPHY: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS
items.abstract_cn: 内镜超声引导下的组织取样广泛用于诊断胰腺病变，但胰腺炎仍是一种具有临床意义的不良事件，且关于其危险因素的证据并不一致。本系统综述和荟萃分析旨在总结内镜超声后胰腺炎的发生率，并评估患者相关和操作相关的危险因素。检索了PubMed、Scopus和Cochrane Library中报告内镜超声后胰腺炎并评估危险因素的研究。在至少两项研究中报告且具有可提取二分类数据的危险因素，采用Mantel–Haenszel固定效应模型，以风险比及95%置信区间进行合并。共纳入五项研究：两项队列研究、一项多中心汇总分析、一项回顾性病例对照研究和一份病例报告。报告的胰腺炎发生率范围为0.29%至9.2%，反映了研究人群和操作风险方面的差异。仅有两项研究提供了适合合并的数据。胰腺炎与性别（风险比1.13；95%置信区间0.48–2.64）、胰腺炎病史（1.50；0.60–3.75）或胰头取样与其他部位取样相比（1.21；0.50–2.94）均无显著关联，且未观察到研究间异质性。在个别研究中，近期急性胰腺炎和分支胰管型导管内乳头状黏液性肿瘤与更高的风险相关。内镜超声引导下胰腺取样后胰腺炎并不常见，其报告发生率随患者选择和操作特征而变化。由于研究和参与者数量较少，合并结果受到限制。近期胰腺炎以及针道穿过胰管或正常胰腺实质可能识别出风险更高的患者，值得进行前瞻性研究。
items.abstract_en: Endoscopic ultrasonography-guided tissue sampling is widely used to diagnose pancreatic lesions, but pancreatitis remains a clinically relevant adverse event, and evidence on its risk factors is inconsistent. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to summarize the incidence of pancreatitis after endoscopic ultrasonography and to evaluate patient- and procedure-related risk factors. PubMed, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies reporting pancreatitis after endoscopic ultrasonography and evaluating risk factors. Risk factors reported in at least two studies with extractable dichotomous data were pooled as risk ratios with 95% confidence intervals using the Mantel–Haenszel fixed-effect model. Five studies were included: two cohort studies, a multicenter pooled analysis, a retrospective case–control study, and a case report. The reported incidence of pancreatitis ranged from 0.29% to 9.2%, reflecting differences in study populations and procedural risk. Only two studies provided data suitable for pooling. Pancreatitis was not significantly associated with sex (risk ratio 1.13; 95% confidence interval 0.48–2.64), history of pancreatitis (1.50; 0.60–3.75), or sampling of the pancreatic head versus other locations (1.21; 0.50–2.94), and no between-study heterogeneity was observed. In individual studies, recent acute pancreatitis and side-branch intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm were associated with a higher risk. Pancreatitis after endoscopic ultrasonography-guided pancreatic sampling is uncommon, and its reported incidence varies with patient selection and procedural characteristics. The pooled findings are limited by the small number of studies and participants. Recent pancreatitis and needle passage through the pancreatic duct or normal parenchyma may identify patients at higher risk and warrant prospective investigation.
items.summary_cn: 该系统综述与荟萃分析发现，EUS引导下胰腺取样后胰腺炎发生率较低（0.29%–9.2%），且与性别、胰腺炎病史或胰腺头部取样无显著关联；近期急性胰腺炎和分支胰管型IPMN在个别研究中与更高风险相关，但汇总结果受研究数量和样本量限制。

items.title_cn: Deepseek-V3、ChatGPT-4o与在线医疗平台解答慢性胰腺炎相关问题的比较
items.title_en: Comparison of Deepseek-V3, ChatGPT-4o, and online medical platforms in addressing chronic pancreatitis related questions
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题比较了Deepseek-V3、ChatGPT-4o与在线医疗平台在回答慢性胰腺炎相关问题上的表现，但提供的摘要为空，无法提取具体发现。

items.title_cn: 内镜超声在自身免疫性胰腺炎中的进展：组织获取、影像创新、人工智能及多学科整合
items.title_en: Advances in endoscopic ultrasound for autoimmune pancreatitis: Tissue acquisition, imaging innovations, artificial intelligence, and multidisciplinary integrations
items.abstract_cn: 自身免疫性胰腺炎（AIP）是一种免疫介导的胰腺炎症性疾病，难以与胰腺恶性肿瘤相鉴别，因此诊断仍具有挑战性。1型AIP是免疫球蛋白G4相关疾病的胰腺表现，可与其他系统性纤维炎症性疾病相关。2型AIP的组织学特征为粒细胞性上皮病变，常与炎症性肠病相关。近年来，超声内镜（EUS）已成为疑似AIP患者诊断评估的重要组成部分，尤其是当影像学检查显示局灶性胰腺肿大或肿块样病变时。EUS成像的最新进展，包括造影增强谐波EUS和EUS弹性成像，可能改善胰腺病变的特征描述，并有助于区分炎症性胰腺过程与胰腺恶性肿瘤。此外，EUS引导下的组织获取在此背景下发挥着重要作用，因为它允许对病变进行组织学评估，从而有助于排除恶性肿瘤。EUS引导下的细针活检是目前首选的组织获取技术，因为它能够保留组织结构，有助于促进AIP的诊断。由肝胆胰内镜、肝病学、风湿病学、放射学、心脏病学、肾脏病学和组织病理学专家组成的多学科团队协作，对于整合诊断评估的不同组成部分并指导后续管理具有重要价值。最后，新兴的EUS人工智能算法可能支持诊断过程并促进AIP的识别。本综述讨论了当前和新兴的EUS技术、组织获取选择、安全性考量、多学科整合以及人工智能在AIP诊断和管理中的潜在作用。
items.abstract_en: Autoimmune pancreatitis (AIP) is an immune-mediated inflammatory condition of the pancreas that can be difficult to differentiate from pancreatic malignancy and therefore remains challenging to diagnose. Type 1 AIP is the pancreatic manifestation of immunoglobulin G subclass 4-related disease and can be associated with other systemic fibro-inflammatory conditions. Type 2 AIP is characterised histologically by granulocytic epithelial lesions and is frequently associated with inflammatory bowel disease. Over the previous years, endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) has become an important part of the diagnostic work-up of patients presenting with suspected AIP, particularly when imaging studies demonstrate focal pancreatic enlargement, or a mass-like lesion. Recent advances in EUS imaging, including contrast-enhanced harmonic EUS and EUS elastography, may improve characterisation of the pancreatic lesion and help distinguish an inflammatory pancreatic process from a pancreatic malignancy. Moreover, EUS-guided tissue acquisition plays an important role in this context by allowing histological assessment of the lesion and hence helping exclude a malignancy. EUS-guided fine-needle biopsy is currently the preferred tissue acquisition technique, as it allows the preservation of tissue architecture, which helps facilitate the diagnosis of AIP. A multidisciplinary approach involving a panel of specialists in hepatopancreatobiliary endoscopy, hepatology, rheumatology, radiology, cardiology, nephrology, and histopathology is valuable for integrating the different components of the diagnostic work-up and guiding subsequent management. Finally, emerging artificial intelligence algorithms for EUS may support the diagnostic process and facilitate recognition of AIP. This review discusses current and emerging EUS techniques, tissue acquisition options, safety considerations, multidisciplinary integration and the potential role of artificial intelligence in the diagnosis and management of AIP.
items.summary_cn: 该综述指出EUS在自身免疫性胰腺炎（AIP）诊断中具有重要作用，尤其是EUS引导的组织获取（推荐FNB以保留组织架构）、对比增强谐波EUS和弹性成像等影像新技术有助于区分炎性病变与胰腺恶性肿瘤；同时强调多学科整合及新兴人工智能算法可辅助AIP的诊断与管理。

items.title_cn: 发现用于治疗重症急性胰腺炎的新型STING抑制剂
items.title_en: Discovery of Novel STING Inhibitors for the Treatment of Severe Acute Pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 摘要：干扰素基因刺激因子（STING）是重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）的一个有前景的治疗靶点，但有效的小分子抑制剂仍然有限。在此，构效关系研究鉴定出化合物D4作为一种强效STING抑制剂，具有良好的细胞活性和安全性。D4直接结合STING，抑制其寡聚化及下游TBK1/IRF3信号传导，并恢复巨噬细胞吞噬功能、自噬流和线粒体功能，同时抑制NOD样受体家族含pyrin结构域3（NLRP3）相关的细胞焦亡。D4表现出口服暴露，生物利用度为24.70%，在1000 mg/kg剂量下无明显毒性。在雨蛙素/LPS诱导的SAP模型中，D4显著减轻胰腺损伤、腺泡细胞坏死、炎症浸润以及血清淀粉酶和脂肪酶水平。STING敲低产生了类似的保护效应。这些发现表明D4是一种有前景的靶向STING的SAP治疗先导化合物。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Stimulator of interferon genes (STING) is a promising therapeutic target for severe acute pancreatitis (SAP), but effective small-molecule inhibitors remain limited. Here, structure−activity relationship studies identified compound D4 as a potent STING inhibitor with favorable cellular activity and safety. D4 directly engaged STING, inhibited its oligomerization and downstream TBK1/IRF3 signaling, and restored macrophage phagocytosis, autophagic flux, and mitochondrial function while suppressing NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain containing 3(NLRP3)-associated pyroptosis. D4 showed oral exposure with 24.70% bioavailability and no overt toxicity at 1000 mg/kg. In a caerulein/LPS-induced SAP model, D4 markedly reduced pancreatic injury, acinar cell necrosis, inflammatory infiltration, and serum amylase and lipase levels. STING knockdown produced similar protective effects. These findings identify D4 as a promising STING-targeting lead compound for SAP treatment.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现化合物D4是一种有效的STING抑制剂，能直接结合STING并抑制其寡聚化及下游TBK1/IRF3信号，同时恢复巨噬细胞吞噬、自噬流和线粒体功能并抑制NLRP3相关焦亡。在雨蛙素/LPS诱导的重症急性胰腺炎模型中，D4显著减轻胰腺损伤、腺泡细胞坏死和炎症浸润，并降低血清淀粉酶和脂肪酶水平。

items.title_cn: 目标导向液体治疗与标准静脉液体治疗在急性胰腺炎治疗中的有效性比较
items.title_en: Effectiveness of Goal-Directed Fluid Therapy (GDFT) in Treatment of Acute Pancreatitis vs Standard IV Fluid Therapy
items.abstract_cn: 背景：急性胰腺炎（AP）是最常见的外科急症之一；其严重程度从轻度自限性炎症到伴有全身炎症反应综合征（SIRS）、器官衰竭和死亡的严重疾病不等。液体复苏是治疗的基石。然而，最佳的液体管理策略仍存在争议。目标导向液体治疗（GDFT）相较于传统经验性液体管理，提供了一种针对患者个体化、以血流动力学为指导的方法。目的：评估GDFT与标准静脉（IV）液体治疗在急性胰腺炎管理中的有效性。方法：在印度马哈拉施特拉邦一家三级教学医院进行了为期两年的比较研究。42例诊断为急性胰腺炎的患者被纳入两组：GDFT组（n=21）和标准液体治疗组（n=21）。GDFT组接受以每搏输出量为导向的晶体液负荷量联合维持液体，而对照组接受传统补液（5-10 ml/kg/小时）。主要终点包括安全性、并发症、ICU入住率和住院时间。统计分析使用SPSS v25.0进行。结果：招募可行性已达成（入组率56%）。GDFT组平均总液体输注量（8965.9ml）低于标准治疗组（9571.4ml），但差异无统计学意义（p=0.1691）。GDFT组平均尿量更高（5719 ml vs 4632 ml，p=0.06）。在死亡率或主要并发症方面未观察到显著差异。GDFT组ICU需求更低。GDFT组住院时间略短。结论：GDFT在病房环境中可行且安全，并可能在不增加并发症的情况下优化液体管理。趋势支持GDFT在改善生理参数和减少ICU需求方面的优势。
items.abstract_en: Background: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is one of the most common surgical emergencies; with severity ranging from mild self-limiting inflammation to severe disease associated with systemic inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS), organ failure, and mortality.Fluid resuscitation is the cornerstone of management.However, the optimal strategy for fluid administration remains controversial.Goal-Directed Fluid Therapy (GDFT) offers a patient-specific, hemodynamically guided approach compared to conventional empirical fluid administration.Aim: To evaluate the effectiveness of GDFT compared to standard intravenous (IV) fluid therapy in the management of acute pancreatitis.Methods: A comparative study was conducted at a tertiary care teaching hospital in Maharashtra over two years.Forty-two patients diagnosed with acute pancreatitis were included into two groups: GDFT (n=21) and Standard Fluid Therapy (n=21).The GDFT group received stroke volume-guided crystalloid boluses with maintenance fluid, while the control group received conventional hydration (5-10 ml/kg/hour).Primary endpoints included safety, complications, ICU admission, and hospital stay.Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS v25.0.Results: Recruitment feasibility was achieved (56% enrolment rate).Mean total fluid administered was lower in GDFT (8965.9ml) compared to Standard Therapy (9571.4ml), though not statistically significant (p=0.1691).Mean urine output was higher in GDFT (5719 ml vs 4632 ml, p=0.06).No significant differences were observed in mortality or major complications.ICU requirement was lower in the GDFT group.Length of hospital stay was marginally shorter in GDFT.Conclusion: GDFT is feasible and safe in ward settings and may optimize fluid administration without increasing complications.The trends favour GDFT in improving physiological parameters and reducing ICU requirement.
items.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
items.summary_cn: 在急性胰腺炎患者中，目标导向液体治疗（GDFT）较标准静脉补液虽未显著减少总输液量或改善死亡率及主要并发症，但显示出更高的尿量、更低的ICU需求和略短的住院时间趋势，且安全可行。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
